newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia PPI flat in October, slows to 0.6 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Croatia PPI flat in October, slows to 0.6 pct y/y.

text.p: The Central Bureau of Statistics issued the following economic indicator details.
CROATIA PRODUCER PRICES OCTOBER JAN-OCT SEPTEMBER OCT '95

NOTES -- October producer prices of capital goods rose 0.1 and of production materials 0.2 percent from September, while consumer goods fell 0.2 percent. Overall, industrial prices were 0.4 percent lower in October than at the end of 1995.
Croatia introduced a radical anti-inflation programme in October 1993, when monthly producer price inflation was running at 29.1 percent.
